blurb: The Foam Lake Visitor Information Centre office is open from the beginning of May to the end of September. We are conveniently located along Highway 16 and offer a beautiful rest spot with picnic tables. The Foam Lake Visitor Information Centre offers a large variety of information for the area and the neighbouring provinces.
